_about: Reviewed compliance decisions (see docs/SOURCE_DISCOVERY.md). 'approved' = no prohibition found at review time; it is NOT legal advice or a legal permission. Re-review is required every 90 days or when robots.txt/terms change.

adafruit.tos_finding: Terms of service read in full (2026-11-06): covers ordering, shipping, customs and returns. No clause restricting automated access, scraping, data extraction or reuse was found. Not an explicit permission.
adafruit.notes: robots.txt (User-agent *) disallows /api/ /ajax/ /search /i/ /includes/ etc.; /product/ and /category/ are allowed. We fetch /category/{105,17,875} and /product/N only, 1 request per 2 s, no search or API paths. Do not store descriptions/images. Affiliate/price API: none found.

sparkfun.tos_finding: Terms/privacy page read in full (2026-11-06): no clause restricting automated access, scraping, data extraction or reuse was found. Not an explicit permission.
sparkfun.notes: robots.txt (User-agent *) sets Crawl-delay: 10 (honoured: one request per 10 s), disallows /catalog/ /search* /api/ /checkout etc.; product pages (clean .html URLs) and /media/sitemap.xml are allowed. URLs with query strings are not fetched. Do not store descriptions/images.

thepihut.com.reason: Shopify merchant terms of service (https://thepihut.com/pages/terms-of-service) prohibit: 'reproduce, duplicate, copy, extract, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Services' and 'use any robot, spider, scraping, data gathering and extraction tool ... (agentic AI) or automated or manual means to access the Services'. robots.txt allows crawling, but the contract forbids it.

coolcomponents.co.uk.reason: robots.txt allows product pages; terms of service contain no automated-access prohibition found. BUT https://coolcomponents.co.uk/agents.md says agent traffic must identify itself via Shopify 'Web Bot Auth' (cryptographic request signing) and use their UCP/MCP interfaces. We cannot meet the identification requirement, so crawling is not enabled. Next step: ask bots@shopify.com / the merchant.

pimoroni.com.reason: No robots.txt (404) and no sitemap; storefront is a JavaScript single-page app (homepage is a 130-byte shell) so HTTP-first extraction yields nothing; terms not located. www.pimoroni.com did not resolve from the sandbox.

kiwi-electronics.com.reason: Redirects to www.kiwi-electronics.com, which was not in the network allowlist; robots/terms not read.
